description: What the page's two dictionaries (frontend/src/words) hold that is not simply the browser texts of docs/design/words.json. tools/product-words.py writes the dictionaries from words.json and from this file, and tools/check-design.py holds the product to both. `own` is a text the product needs and words.json does not have, with why. `unused` is a browser text of words.json the product does not use, with why. `server` is a label the gateway writes in English and the page says in the reader's language (frontend/src/serverWords.ts), with the Rust that writes it, so that a label the gateway changes fails the check instead of going stale.
